questions.explanation: J is letter 10. 10 + 2 = 12, and letter 12 is L.

questions.explanation: O is letter 15. 15 − 4 = 11, and letter 11 is K.

questions.explanation: H (8) is 8 − 2 = 6 places after B (2). 6 places after P (16) is 22, the letter V.

questions.question: Which letter is as far after P as J is after D in the alphabet?

questions.question: Which letter is as far after F as N is after I in the alphabet?

questions.explanation: The 17th letter from the end is letter 27 − 17 = 10, which is J.

questions.question: Which letter is exactly halfway between G and K in the alphabet?
questions.explanation: G = 7 and K = 11. Halfway is (7 + 11) ÷ 2 = 9, the letter I.

questions.question: Counting from the start of the alphabet (A is 1st), D is in place 4. Which letter is in place 4 counting from the end (Z is 1st)?

questions.question: Which letter is exactly halfway between J and V in the alphabet?
questions.explanation: J = 10 and V = 22. Halfway is (10 + 22) ÷ 2 = 16, the letter P.
